svg.title: BrandSight — animated logo
svg.desc: SMIL-animated logo: closed eye (lashes down) holds 5 s, then 3 s crossfade to open eye (oval + iris), holds 5 s, blinks 3× at 0.5 s each, holds 5 s, then 3 s crossfade back to closed, holds 5 s. 29.0 s cycle, infinite loop. Wordmark static. Coral accent (#ffb48f) over graphite (#1a2433).
